description_en: Initiate an outbound call using the Intelligent Contact Robot
description_zh: 发起智能联络机器人呼出
name: RobotCall

parameters.help_en: Outbound caller number. View it in the Voice Service Real Number Management (https://dyvmsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal) interface
parameters.help_zh: 呼出主叫号码。在语音服务真实号管理 (https://dyvmsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal)界面查看
parameters.name: called_show_number

parameters.help_en: Robot ID, which is the script ID. View the reviewed and approved script ID in the Script Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/patter/list) interface
parameters.help_zh: 机器人ID，即话术ID。在话术管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/patter/list)界面查看审核通过的话术ID
parameters.name: robot_id

parameters.help_en: An ID reserved for the caller. This ID will be returned to the caller through the receipt message. It must be 1 to 15 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 预留给调用方使用的 ID，最终会通过回执消息将此 ID 带回给调用方，长度为 1~15 个字节
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en:
Whether to record the call. Valid values:

false (default): Do not record.
true: Record
parameters.help_zh:
通话过程是否录音。取值：

false（默认值）：不录音。
true：录音
parameters.name: record_flag

parameters.help_en:
Whether to enable the number status detection identity. Valid values:  

false (Default Value): Disable.  
true: Enable.  
When enabled, the reason for unanswered calls will be recorded.
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用号码状态识别标识。取值：

false（默认值）：不启用。
true：启用。
启用后会记录通话未接听的原因
parameters.name: early_media_asr

parameters.help_en: Parameter list for the robot, in JSON format. The total length must not exceed 512 bytes. You can view the parameters in Script Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/patter/list) > Details > Input Parameters, or by using the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717999.html API
parameters.help_zh: 机器人的参数列表。JSON格式。总长度不要超过512个字节。在话术管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/patter/list)>详情>输出输入参数中查看或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717999.html接口查看
parameters.name: params

Code.description_en: Request status code. A return value of "OK" indicates that the request succeeded
Code.description_zh: 请求状态码。返回OK代表请求成功

Data.description_en: The unique receipt ID of this call, which is also the unique call ID
Data.description_zh: 此次通话的唯一回执ID，即呼叫唯一ID
